info.title: Fenergo Financial Analysis Command API
info.description:
**Fenergo Financial Analysis Command API**:
Financial Analysis Command API provides both configurational and operational methods related to the client financial analysis. Use the Financial Analysis Command API to create and update new and existing financial analysis data. Use the Query API to retrieve financial analysis data.
**Financial Analysis Command API provides**:
  • The ability to manage Financial Analysis Set.
  • The ability to manage Financial Analysis Version.
  • The ability to update Financial Analysis Schema.
